mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and increased blood flow to skin; tazarotene causes local irritation and erythema which may be potentiated by minoxidil's vasodilatory effects, increasing dermal sensitivity and adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation, erythema, and dermatitis; consider staggered application times or dose adjustment of tazarotene; counsel patient on potential for enhanced local adverse effects.
